post.excerpt: A new AI Insights page on Cloudflare Radar includes bot & crawler traffic trends, a view into Generative AI service popularity based on 1.1.1.1 DNS resolver traffic, the usage of robots.txt directives to restrict AI bot access to content, and open source model usage as seen by Cloudflare Workers AI.
post.title: No hallucinations here: track the latest AI trends with expanded insights on Cloudflare Radar
